reply.text: Appreciate you asking before just going for it. Short answer: no, skip true 1RM maxing at 16 — growth plates are still a factor, and the risk-to-reward isn't worth it for a number. You can still build real strength with heavier work in the 3-6 rep range at a hard-but-controlled effort, which gets you almost all the same signal without grinding a true max. If you want, I can help you think through how to test strength safely within that range.
